parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures are the Total column of the Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation table, which is in thousands. The release also shows the prior sequential quarter (three months ended Dec 31, 2025), included above. Trailing-twelve-month Adjusted EBITDA used for the leverage ratio is excluded because it is not a fiscal year-to-date or full-year figure: $154,880 for the 12 months ended Mar 31, 2026 and $207,612 for the 12 months ended Mar 31, 2025. The other quarterly figures that appear only in those LTM tables are also excluded: Jun 30, 2025 $42,719; Sep 30, 2025 $38,942; Jun 30, 2024 $57,676; Sep 30, 2024 $45,817; Dec 31, 2024 $58,859.
